title: HandFill
description: The hand-completion record for the firm_default lane (P26a item 1, P1-27 — the owner's call, 2026-09-02): the values a human typed for the template slots the engine never drafts — the proposal-metadata record, the pricing grid, the case block, the inline bracketed line. One artifact per pursuit under exports/, last write wins per slot, every value server-stamped (entered_by from the session, at from the server clock). The fill renders these values into the template in place; nothing here is computed — a fee is a string a human typed (P3-1 pricing scope untouched). Bound to the exact template the plan was built against: template_sha256 must equal the path_b_outline checkpoint's reference_sha256 or the fill refuses.

template_sha256.description: sha256 of the firm template these values address (the digest-bound-source rule, B74§3b) — a mismatch at fill time refuses.

entered_by.description: The operator who made the LAST write (session identity, server-stamped — never a client field).

at.description: The server clock at the last write (P0-11: the client never supplies a clock).

values.description: slot_id -> value. A record slot takes {field_key: text}; a table slot (grid or case block) takes [{field_key: text}, …] — one object per row or entry; the inline bracketed line takes a string. Keys are the slot's own response_fields keys; the door refuses any other slot, key, or shape.
